title: Mogitate SegaSaturn Vol. 3
native_title: モギタテセガサターン Ｖｏｌ．３ １９９８．５
overview: The third issue of Mogitate Sega Saturn, the information disc sent to members of Sega Partners, Sega's Saturn fan club. Sections include a Partners Special feature, a look at new Saturn software, and Dreamcast Scoop, a corner with early news and footage of Sega's next console.
